[ASSISTANT_SAID] Climate policies can affect trade by increasing costs of certain products or industries, potentially leading to trade barriers or disputes.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Developed nations argue that climate policies can promote innovation and create economic opportunities, while developing nations often prioritize economic growth.
